# A gitlink is just another file to git. A branch cut BEFORE a re-pin carries the
# old commit, and merging it moves the pointer BACK without a conflict or a
# visible diff in review (2026-09-21: merging #615 rolled universal-gnss from
# v0.7.1-rc3 to a September snapshot with no universal_gnss_msgs — every Docker
# build died on "universal_gnss_msgs: not found"). Re-pinning now means changing
# the gitlink AND this file in the same commit; CI fails when they disagree.
